description: Preview (dry-run) of an arbitrage pair order: stock quantity and the Hyperliquid order it would send. Nothing is ever sent from this server. Hyperliquid side is priced on testnet (the default network), so its price can differ from mainnet

asset.description: SMSN=Samsung Electronics, SKHX=SK hynix, HYUNDAI=Hyundai Motor, SKHY=SK hynix ADR (0.1 share), KR200=KOSPI 200, EWY=MSCI Korea ETF, KORU=3x Korea ETF

direction.description: perp_short_stock_long = sell the Hyperliquid perp and buy the stock (the only direction retail can do without short-selling stock). Use net.direction from get_arbitrage

notionalKrw.description: Trade size in KRW. get_arbitrage with the same notionalKrw shows the expected fill prices, slippage and net for this size

name: preview_pair_order
